messages:
Carla (Docs): Opening a small docs PR to update the model catalog—mainly: supported models list, updated limits (seq len / tokens), benchmark snippets, and compatibility notes for quantized variants. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
Ben (Eng-ML): Thanks. Do we have final max seq limits for Aether and Mistral variants? The old cards show 8192 but we tested 12288 for Aether-7B last week.
Mike (Eng-Runtime): For Aether-7B (non-quant) we validated up to 12288 with our fallback paging; quant variants still recommended at 8192. I'll paste numbers below.
Alice (DevEx): I'll update the SDK snippets — want both python + ts streaming examples and a quant flag example. Do we want to show the new max_seq in the snippet or just state the catalog limit?
Carla (Docs): Put numbers in the limits table and call out "practical limit" vs "tested max" in compatibility notes. Examples should set a conservative default (8192) and show how to override.
Mike (Eng-Runtime): Benchmark quickpaste:
```
# bench command
./bench/run_infer.sh --model aether-7b --quant false --seq 1024 --batch 1
# result: ~28ms/token on A100-80GB (driver v515)
./bench/run_infer.sh --model aether-7b --quant true --seq 1024 --batch 1
# result: ~18ms/token
```
Ben (Eng-ML): Add a short note: quantized throughput wins but watch for small-quality regressions on long-context completions.
Sophia (Docs-Reviewer): There's a broken link in the existing card to /docs/guides/quantization.md (404). Replace with /docs/guides/quantization-guide and add a redirect note.
Alice (DevEx): Draft py snippet (will add to PR):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
res = client.generate("Summarize this text...", model="aether-7b", max_tokens=256, max_seq_len=8192)
print(res.text)
```
Alice (DevEx): TS streaming example:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'aether-7b', prompt: 'Write a short blurb' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```
Carla (Docs): Nice. I'll add those snippets and the bench numbers to the model card. Also planning to add a short migration note: "If you upgrade from catalog v1 to v2, default max_seq may change—check compatibility notes." Can we also add a "known issues" bullet for kernel incompatibility on 32-bit systems?
Mike (Eng-Runtime): Yes — add a known issue: "quant builds may crash on older drivers; see runtime release notes." I'll link the internal kernel issue #879.
Carla (Docs): I'll push a tiny commit to fix the link, add the limits table row, include the py/ts snippets, and append the benchmark numbers. Assigning reviewers: @Ben, @Mike, @Alice, @Sophia. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
docs-ci (bot): CI passed — 6 checks, 0 failed. https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/412
Ben (Eng-ML): LGTM from me, left one nit about phrasing in compatibility note.
Alice (DevEx): Quick nit on TS import path — we use `@redwood/inference-client` in our packages, can fix in the snippet. Otherwise good. :thumbsup:
Sophia (Docs-Reviewer): Approved after link fix. :white_check_mark:
Carla (Docs): Thanks everyone — I'll merge after addressing the small nits (Alice + Ben). Will follow up if runtime team wants more detailed bench sections.
